requirements: At least 3 years of experience in QA, SDET, or test automation, including building test suites or automation frameworks.
Strong Go experience writing integration tests or backend test automation, plus experience building end-to-end web UI tests.
Experience using TypeScript, React, Kubernetes, Linux, CI/CD systems, and RPC protocols such as gRPC in testing or quality work.
Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Alertmanager, or Grafana.
Experience with AI-powered or conversational products and building evaluations is valuable.
Exposure to multicluster tooling, Kubernetes testing, chaos engineering, Playwright, or Slack apps is a plus.
Experience building test infrastructure from scratch or being an early-stage company's first QA hire is beneficial.
responsibilities: Join an early-stage AI infrastructure company as its first QA engineer, owning quality across a platform for managing GPU clusters. You will test conversational and web interfaces alongside the Kubernetes-based backend, helping ensure cluster operations are accurate, safe, and reliable.
Test conversational workflows end to end, including command accuracy and actions performed on live clusters.
Build evaluations for AI agent behavior, checking answer quality, safe actions, and responses to ambiguous or invalid requests.
Create end-to-end tests for the web interface and verify consistent behavior across interfaces.
Write Go integration tests for backend workflows, including installation, upgrades, and failover.
Provision and tear down Kubernetes test clusters to validate controllers, operators, and custom resources across versions.
Verify that alerts trigger appropriately and reach the relevant interfaces.
